title: galium sylvestre var. silvivagum
intro: Galium sylvestre var. silvivagum, commonly known as Woodruff or Galium, is a perennial herb belonging to the Rubiaceae family. It has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties that may aid in wound healing and reduce fever. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its ability to stimulate digestion, relieve coughs, and treat respiratory issues such as bronchitis and asthma. The bioactive constituents of Galium sylvestre var. silvivagum include iridoid glycosides, phenolic acids, and flavonoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
